rationale: Discography populator: full tracklist (31 tracks) per https://tylerthecreator.fandom.com/wiki/Live_at_Splash!, https://www.cancioneros.com/lyrics/disc_amp/528021/live-at-splash-tyler-the-creator. 2013 official live album released Sept 3, 2013 by Creative Concerts (label also confirmed on Musicboard). 31 tracks including 9 interludes, drawn from Wolf, Bastard, Goblin, and The OF Tape Vol. 2. Track order identical across Fandom, cancioneros.com, top-charts.com, lyreka.com, and Qobuz. NOT a bootleg - was an officially released live album available on streaming services.
